channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Trump sues UC over alleged hostile environment for Jewish and Israeli UCLA employees
item.description: The Trump administration on Tuesday sued the University of California over what it said is an 'ongoing hostile work environment' for Jewish and Israeli employees.

item.title: Ousted L.A. fire chief accuses Mayor Bass of retaliation in Palisades fire whistleblower lawsuit
item.description: In the lawsuit, Kristin Crowley and her attorneys allege L.A. Mayor Karen Bass sought to shift blame for the way the city handled last year’s catastrophic Palisades fire to Crowley amid mounting criticism.

item.title: Trump's plan for rising energy costs: Pump oil, make data centers pay
item.description: In his State of the Union address, Trump laid out a plan to address rising consumer energy costs: Double down on fossil fuels like oil and coal, and make AI data centers pay for their own power.

item.title: Man snatched from California Sikh temple in fatal case of mistaken identity, officials say
item.description: Avtar Singh, 57, was kidnapped from a temple in Tracy on Feb. 17, possibly in a case of mistaken identity. His body was found days later.

item.title: California woman whose parents were deported to attend President Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: U.S. Rep Mike Levin, whose district includes parts of O.C. and San Diego counties, will attend the State of the Union and bring the daughter of an O.C. couple who were deported last year as his guest.

item.title: Trump awards Team USA's goalie the Presidential Medal of Freedom
item.description: President Trump announced during his State of the Union that he was awarding Team USA's hockey goalie Connor Hellebuyck the Presidential Medal of Freedom.

item.title: Trump delivers longest State of the Union address in modern history
item.description: President Trump, speaking for nearly two hours, broke prior records with the length of his State of the Union speech on Tuesday.

item.title: Takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address
item.description: President Trump struck a confident and defiant tone in a nearly two-hour State of the Union speech.

item.title: After State of the Union, Democrats say Trump did 'what he does best: lie'
item.description: In a rebuttal to the State of the Union address delivered on behalf of the Democratic Party, Sen. Alex Padilla accused Trump of plunging U.S. cities into violence and hindering the economy.

item.title: Trump boasts of a 'golden age' in State of the Union amid sharp partisan divisions
item.description: More than 30 congressional Democrats boycotted President Trump's State of the Union address. Others attended alternative events.
